class LoopPolicyTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_incomplete_never_stops_when_laya_says_stop(self):
        x = evaluate(snapshot(), {'choice': 'stop', 'answer_confidence': 0.99, 'model': 'laya/english'})
        self.assertEqual(x['action'], 'CONTINUE')
        self.assertFalse(x['completion_claim_allowed'])
        self.assertIn('Laya cannot certify', x['laya_note'])

    def test_verified_stop_requires_independent_review(self):
        base = dict(deliverables_verified=True, requirements_coverage_verified=True,
                    evidence_hashes_verified=True, tests=[{'id': 'T-1', 'status': 'PASS', 'evidence_ref': 'log-01'}],
                    blocking_defects=0)
        self.assertEqual(evaluate(snapshot(**base))['action'], 'REQUEST_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW')
        base['review'] = {'status':'PASS', 'author_id':'builder', 'reviewer_id':'qa-2', 'evidence_ref':'qa-log'}
        x = evaluate(snapshot(**base))
        self.assertEqual(x['action'], 'STOP_VERIFIED')
        self.assertTrue(x['completion_claim_allowed'])

    def test_self_review_does_not_qualify(self):
        x=evaluate(snapshot(deliverables_verified=True, requirements_coverage_verified=True,
                            evidence_hashes_verified=True, tests=[{'id':'T','status':'PASS','evidence_ref':'e'}],
                            blocking_defects=0, review={'status':'PASS', 'author_id':'builder',
                                                       'reviewer_id':'builder', 'evidence_ref':'qa'}))
        self.assertEqual(x['action'], 'REQUEST_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW')

    def test_same_failure_forces_strategy_change(self):
        x=evaluate(snapshot(consecutive_same_remedy_failures=2))
        self.assertEqual(x['action'], 'CHANGE_STRATEGY')
        self.assertFalse(x['completion_claim_allowed'])

    def test_three_distinct_failures_pause_instead_of_infinite_spend(self):
        x=evaluate(snapshot(distinct_strategies_failed=3))
        self.assertEqual(x['action'], 'PAUSE_UNRESOLVED')

    def test_low_confidence_or_absent_laya_cannot_change_strategy(self):
        for advice in [None, {'choice':'change_strategy', 'answer_confidence':0.2, 'model':'laya/english'},
                       {'choice':'change_strategy', 'confidence':0.99, 'model':'laya/english'}]:
            x=evaluate(snapshot(stalled=True), advice)
            self.assertEqual(x['action'], 'CONTINUE')

    def test_valid_laya_advice_can_change_stalled_strategy_not_progressing_one(self):
        advice={'choice':'change_strategy', 'answer_confidence':0.82, 'model':'laya/english'}
        self.assertEqual(evaluate(snapshot(stalled=True), advice)['action'], 'CHANGE_STRATEGY')
        self.assertEqual(evaluate(snapshot(stalled=False), advice)['action'], 'CONTINUE')

    def test_permissions_and_budget_require_safe_stop_not_complete(self):
        self.assertEqual(evaluate(snapshot(authority_blocked=True))['action'], 'ESCALATE_AUTHORITY')
        x=evaluate(snapshot(budget_remaining_units=0))
        self.assertEqual(x['action'], 'PAUSE_RESOURCE_BUDGET')
        self.assertFalse(x['completion_claim_allowed'])

    def test_broken_integrity_blocks_even_full_green(self):
        x=evaluate(snapshot(source_integrity_verified=False, deliverables_verified=True,
            requirements_coverage_verified=True, evidence_hashes_verified=True,
            blocking_defects=0, tests=[{'id':'T','status':'PASS','evidence_ref':'e'}],
            review={'status':'PASS','author_id':'builder','reviewer_id':'qa','evidence_ref':'qa-log'}))
        self.assertEqual(x['action'], 'PAUSE_INTEGRITY')

    def test_skipped_tests_never_pass(self):
        x=evaluate(snapshot(deliverables_verified=True, requirements_coverage_verified=True,
            evidence_hashes_verified=True, blocking_defects=0,
            tests=[{'id':'T','status':'SKIPPED','evidence_ref':'e'}],
            review={'status':'PASS','author_id':'builder','reviewer_id':'qa','evidence_ref':'qa-log'}))
        self.assertNotEqual(x['action'], 'STOP_VERIFIED')

    def test_malformed_snapshot_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            evaluate(snapshot(budget_remaining_units='500'))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
